scope: Process-only owned Wayland maximize/unmaximize diagnostic through upstream vkcube resize and oldSwapchain paths
notes: Pixel byte bound excludes stride padding, depth, textures, driver objects and all allocation overhead; existing Android bridge independently checks actual source and destination allocation sizes.
Compositor may refuse maximization or choose extents; require actual configure state, changed extent and oldSwapchain creation before reporting observed recreation.
No wl_seat binding in opt-in mode; compositor socket peer UID/PID is checked before registry binding.
Uses upstream existing presentation/retirement behavior; does not qualify explicit presentation-engine retirement or maintenance1 fences.

Actual swapchain image count is checked after creation; minImageCount requests cannot impose an allocation ceiling on a Vulkan implementation. Refuse counts above four before application image-view/framebuffer allocations.
No source checkout edits or firmware changes; stage the pinned patch on a copy.
Six sample markers follow demo_draw and frame advancement without child waits; host observations must separately prove animation within each configured size.

presentation_scope: Six sampled images show native cube rotation before, during and after one controlled maximize/restore cycle with the qualified feedback candidate; individual physical frames were not all observed
